description: This is a Java service class named PdfService responsible for generating PDF documents related to clients and contracts, such as printing client lists and individual contract details using the iText library.

classes.name: PdfService
classes.description: A Spring service component that provides methods for generating PDF documents with client and contract details.

methods.name: printClientList
methods.description: Generates a PDF file listing client details in a tabular format.

methods.name: makeTablePdf
methods.description: Creates a PDF document with a table populated with provided data.

methods.name: printContract
methods.description: Creates a PDF document with contract details, including client info, company info, and contractual specifics.
